title: Weather diary sheet with weather symbols, one week
subject: Science
unit: Spring 1: Everyday materials (Moon Zoom! and Rain & Sunrays)
source: Seeded from science/y1 lesson 8 (Weather diary sheet with weather symbols, one week (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 8: Winter weather and short days. To understand that winter has cold weather and short days

questions.q: Name two kinds of winter weather.
questions.a: For example: frost and rain, or snow and wind
questions.model: Look outside. It is cold. There is frost on the grass. Frost and wind are winter weather.

questions.q: Are winter days long or short?
What do we wear in winter to keep warm?
questions.a: For example: a coat, hat, gloves, scarf

questions.q: Core: Start your weather diary. Draw today's weather and write one word.
questions.a: For example: a cloud and the word 'cloudy'
questions.model: Teacher shows it first: I look out. It is grey and wet. I draw a cloud with rain. I write 'rainy'.

questions.q: Extend: Ask an adult what time the Sun will set today.
questions.a: About 4 to 5 o'clock in January and early February in the UK

questions.q: Stretch: Is the sunset earlier or later than last week?
questions.a: A little later, because the days are getting longer after winter begins

questions.q: Big question: why is it dark when we eat dinner in winter?
questions.a: Because winter days are short and the Sun sets early
